remarks: Welcome to Maple Plaza...a quiet, serene association of only six townhouses. Ready to be WOWed? This fully updated, tastefully decorated 3-level unit is ready for its new loving owner. Main level is your entertaining space. It consists of the living room w/custom built ins, dining room w/sliders that walk out onto a great size deck and fully remodeled spectacular kitchen that is sure to wow you with its gorgeous quartz countertops and updated SS appliances. Powder room on the main level right at the entrance to the lower level family room that is beautifully finished and heated. The variety of uses this amazing space has is phenomenal...office, play room, movie theater, yoga studio, dance studio, gym, art studio...whatever it is, this space can encompass it. Lower level is where the washer and dryer is located as well. Then enter upstairs into your very own relaxation oasis with two excellent size BDs with generous size closets, fully remodeled BR, linen closet and access to the attic. Hardwood floors and recessed lights throughout, water heater (3 yrs old), custom closet shelving, upgraded doors and windows, upgraded thermostats (six total), vinyl flooring in the lower level, painted throughout, this unit is pet friendly, comes with two dedicated parking spaces and can be rented as well. Minutes to Darien and Stamford beaches, walk to train, easy access to I-95 and Merritt Pkwy, Downtown Stamford...nothing to do but move in and unpack. Don't wait...it will not last!!!
